body:
Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (2)
1. A pending photo can be shared twice 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>save(p) adds a photo to saveAll.handed only after its share promise resolves, while
>saveAll.tap() neither tracks nor excludes a per-photo share in progress. If someone taps a
>received photo and then taps Save all before that share settles, the batch includes the same photo
>and starts another share operation; a concurrent-share rejection also incorrectly puts Save all into
>download-on-next-tap mode.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/index.html[327]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/132/files#diff-8f62b6ced28d3396b501d2e89a2e7cb761d16cd7dc977aebece03d4a5da5c24eR327-R327) > >```diff >+ if (navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) navigator.share({ files: [file] }).then(() => saveAll.handed.add(p.pid), () => {}); >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A per-photo share is not recorded until its promise succeeds, so Save all can start another share for that photo while the first sheet is open. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/index.html[326-343] >- web/saveall.js[24-47] >## Recommended Fix >Coordinate in-flight per-photo and batch handoffs through shared pending state. Exclude a pending photo from a new batch without marking it permanently handed over; clear its pending state on cancellation or failure so a later tap can retry it. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/c4b49830-4c2d-47a6-b624-cef0ae73cf28?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/c4b49830-4c2d-47a6-b624-cef0ae73cf28)
View medium (1)
2. Users aren't told when downloads fail 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>tap() announces Downloading ${ready.length} before starting the files, then catches each
>synchronous download failure with only a console warning. When a download call throws, that file
>remains eligible for retry but the page gives no indication that its download never started.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[54]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/132/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR54-R54) > >```diff >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Save all silently continues after a download call throws, leaving the person unaware that one or more files were not handed to the browser. >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[50-55] >## Recommended Fix >Count synchronous download failures while continuing with the remaining files. After the batch, show a message naming the failed count and indicating that another tap can retry those files; keep failed PIDs out of `handed`. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/dc91dc91-8714-409b-ac5c-0581b7b8094f?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/dc91dc91-8714-409b-ac5c-0581b7b8094f)
